title: Suited Up to Revitalize Teralta Park!
description:
Today, City of San Diego staff and volunteers suited up to revitalize Teralta Park in City Heights. 

8 new trees were planted and fresh paint was added to the playground, planters and light posts. 🎨 🖌️ 🌳 

We believe in creating safe and accessible parks for our communities and growing a green San Diego.

Thank you to everyone who helped make this happen! 💚
